name: Strategic Planning
description: Develops and executes long-term organizational strategies, serves as strategic compass for all business activities

roles.name: Strategic Planner
roles.description: Develops and implements long-term organizational strategies, ensuring alignment with company vision and goals
responsibilities: Conduct market research and analysis to inform strategic decisions
Create and maintain strategic roadmaps and action plans
Monitor and evaluate strategic initiatives to ensure alignment with business objectives
Provide strategic guidance to cross-functional teams

roles.name: Strategic Analyst
roles.description: Analyzes market trends, competitive landscapes, and industry dynamics to inform strategic decisions
responsibilities: Conduct market research and analysis to inform strategic decisions
Create and maintain strategic roadmaps and action plans
Monitor and evaluate strategic initiatives to ensure alignment with business objectives
Provide strategic guidance to cross-functional teams

roles.name: Strategic Advisor
roles.description: Provides strategic guidance and expertise to cross-functional teams
responsibilities: Conduct market research and analysis to inform strategic decisions
Create and maintain strategic roadmaps and action plans
Monitor and evaluate strategic initiatives to ensure alignment with business objectives
Provide strategic guidance to cross-functional teams

plan.prompt: Develop a strategic plan for the company.
Analyze the strategic-planning's output and provide feedback and suggestions for improvement.
Provide strategic guidance and expertise from the strategic-analyst's output.
Update the strategic-planning's output based on the strategic-analysis's output and the strategic-advisory's output.
